CustomField.description: Explicit position of this account in the hierarchy: Corporate or Practice. Set at creation by every account-creating path. Replaces inferring level from ParentId, which cannot classify unparented accounts - notably those created by the HubSpot integration - and replaces Is_Practice_Account__c, which is derived from Practice_ID__c and so stays blank until an opportunity closes won. Deliberately left blank where the level is not yet known; treat blank as unclassified, never as a default.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Corporate = the top of a practice group. Practice = an individual location. Leave blank if genuinely unknown rather than guessing.
CustomField.label: Account Level
